InstaShop offers you a hassle-free online shopping experience by bringing all your local supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants, bakeries, butcheries, pet shops & more to your fingertips. 

FIND ALL THE SHOPS YOU LOVE:
From Spinneys, Carrefour, Choithrams, ZOOM, PAUL, Café Bateel, Dunkin’ and Marks & Spencer to Eataly, KIKO Milano, NYX, Al Meera and more. Search for your favourite shop or scroll to discover new ones (there’s always room for a new favourite shop).

Download the app to see which stores are available in your area. 

INSTANT ONLINE DELIVERY:
Just place your order and get it delivered in as little as 30 to 60 minutes, depending on your location. Need it later? You can always schedule your order to receive it at your convenience. 

WIDE PRODUCT VARIETY:
Browse more than 1,000,000 products and find everything you’re looking for; from the snacks you’re craving, to ingredients you’re missing for your favourite recipe, household products, pet supplies, pharmacy supplies, fresh produce, mouth-watering desserts and more.

SAME STORE PRICES:
All the products you select will be delivered at same store prices and without any mark-ups. 

AVAILABLE APP SERVICES*:
-        Grocery delivery
-        Pharmacy delivery
-        Butchery & BBQ delivery
-        Pet shop supplies
-        Specialty shops
-        Flower delivery
-        Fresh produce market
-        Organic products
-        Bakeries & cakes delivery 
-        Seafood delivery
-        Stationery delivery 
-        Home & living delivery
-        Water gallons delivery

-        Perfumes delivery

*The availability of the services depends on user location. Download the app to see which stores are available in your area.  


DELIVERY LOCATIONS:
Find us in the United Arab Emirates, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar, Egypt, Lebanon & Greece.

Have questions? Feel free to reach out to us on contact@instashop.ae

If you’re enjoying InstaShop, please take a moment to rate us on the App Store. Thank you for the support!
